description: This file defines an immutable class 'GrainDirectoryPartitionSnapshot' that models a snapshot of a partition within the Orleans grain directory system, including membership version and list of grain addresses.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryPartitionSnapshot
classes.description: An immutable class representing a snapshot of a grain directory partition, encapsulating the directory's membership version and a list of grain addresses.

methods.name: DirectoryMembershipVersion
methods.description: Getter for the directory's membership version.

methods.name: GrainAddresses
methods.description: Getter for the list of grain addresses associated with this snapshot.
